The power switch applies power to the frequency counter. It must be depressed to turn the unit on........
Signals are applied to either the "A" or "B" input depending on the frequency of the signal measured.
The A input is used for frequencies from 10 Hz to 100 MHz. The
10 MHz or 100 MHz switch selects the range for this input.
The B input is used for frequencies from 100 MHz to 1 GHz. The 1GHz range switch must be selected for this input.
Function switches select between Check, Totalize, Period, and Frequency ranges.
A digital display is used to indicate the quantity measured.
Three gate time selections provide adjustable resolution and
change the time required to update the display.
